payload.title: Low-dimensional nonlinear coefficient learning
payload.statement: Split-local prediction of a small number of nonlinear correction coefficients or control points can recover materially more of E010 candidate coverage than flat family/candidate ranking, while remaining memory-safe and falling back exactly to E006 when confidence is weak.
payload.evidence_for: E011 independently reproduces spline4_ridge_equal_s075 at 12.5507562957 RMSE versus E006 at 14.9331407872. It wins all five maps and all 25 repeated cells, improves every spatial/typewell holdout and registered special slice, and passes all 21 controls under two threads.
payload.evidence_against: Statistical promotion does not establish deployment parity. E011 still lacks a verified inference package, local notebook parity, approximately 200-well hidden-scale runtime receipt, and private internet-disabled Kaggle parity.
payload.next_test: T020/E012: package the exact verified spline4_ridge_equal_s075 path, prove local notebook parity, benchmark approximately 200 pseudo-hidden wells, and obtain private internet-disabled Kaggle parity without submitting.
